contract: One canonical recorded payload per DISTINCT moment value declared by docs/fleet-capability-matrix.json (13 launcher verbs + 3 hermes callbacks + 2 explicit moments = 18; none excluded). T-04/T-08 assert local vs remote envelope equality against these same payloads. Values are deterministic (fixed session id suffix 0280, fixed namespace, fixed paths) so seeded-store builds are reproducible byte-for-byte on every machine.
